title: Mass-summable series of currents; integer multiplicity of sums of integer multiplicity currents
statement: Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (VO) the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (MR) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W; (IMC) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ (K ⊆ U compact); (b) the restriction (M ∩ E, θ, ξ) of an IMRep to a Borel E is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier. (These are exactly the frozen Lean types of the parent node's resolved dependencies, written as antecedents so that the child does not need those declarations; the parent instantiates them.) Let P, k ∈ ℕ and W_i ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ, domain univ) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ (tsum in [0, ∞]). Then there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) such that: for every test form ω, the series Σ_i W_i(ω) has sum S(ω) (HasSum); M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i); spt S ⊆ closure(⋃_i spt W_i); and if every W_i is integer multiplicity then S is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (W : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), ∑' i, (W i).mass < ∞ → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun i => W i ω) (S ω)) ∧ S.mass ≤ ∑' i, (W i).mass ∧ S.support ⊆ closure (⋃ i, (W i).support) ∧ ((∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (W i)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S)
